pictures.scene: Ilya Repin, Ceremonial Sitting of the State Council — the whole council seated in its great hall under the high windows, a Psalm of Asaph, God presides in the divine assembly
pictures.name: pd_repin_gossovet

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, De Staalmeesters — the board of judges looking up together from their table at the one who has come in, He renders judgment among the gods, how long will you judge unjustly
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_staalmeesters

pictures.scene: Vasily Pukirev, The Unequal Marriage — the rich old man given the young girl at the altar while the priest holds out the ring, and show partiality to the wicked
pictures.name: pd_pukirev_nerovny_brak

pictures.scene: David Adolph Constant Artz, In het weeshuis te Katwijk-Binnen — the orphan children sitting together in the bare hall of the orphanage, defend the cause of the weak and fatherless, uphold the rights of the afflicted and oppressed
pictures.name: pd_artz_weeshuis

pictures.scene: Winslow Homer, The Life Line — the helpless one carried out of the breaking sea on the rope, rescue the weak and needy, save them from the hand of the wicked
pictures.name: pd_homer_life_line

pictures.scene: Frederick McCubbin, Lost — the child standing alone in the scrub with no way out of it, they do not know or understand, they wander in the darkness
pictures.name: pd_mccubbin_lost

pictures.scene: Egbert van der Poel, Het springen van de kruittoren in Delft — the whole town thrown down in one instant and the sky full of what had been its houses, all the foundations of the earth are shaken, I have said you are gods
pictures.name: pd_poel_delft

pictures.scene: Albert Edelfelt, Conveying a Child's Coffin — the small coffin rowed out across the still water with the flowers held beside it, you are all sons of the Most High, but like mortals you will die
pictures.name: pd_edelfelt_ruumissaatto

pictures.scene: Paul Delaroche, The Execution of Lady Jane Grey — the young queen brought blindfolded down to the block, and like rulers you will fall, arise O God judge the earth
pictures.name: pd_delaroche_jane_grey

pictures.scene: Eugène von Guérard, North-east view from the northern top of Mount Kosciusko — the man standing on the summit rock with range after range of the earth opened out before him, for all the nations are Your inheritance
pictures.name: pd_guerard_kosciusko

lines.text: God presides in the divine assembly;
He renders judgment among the gods:
and show partiality to the wicked?
Defend the cause of the weak and fatherless;
uphold the rights of the afflicted and oppressed.
save them from the hand of the wicked.
They do not know or understand;
all the foundations of the earth are shaken.
you are all sons of the Most High.’
But like mortals you will die,
and like rulers you will fall.”
Arise, O God, judge the earth,
for all the nations are Your inheritance.
